electric-cobalt.$description: Electric Cobalt — Violet wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

gallery-black.$description: Gallery Black — Primary text, product titles, prices, navigation links, icon strokes, and dominant fill on collection overlay labels

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, product image backgrounds, and inverse text on dark imagery and the cobalt announcement bar

hairline-gray.$description: Hairline Gray — Primary border color, page canvas background, card dividers, list separators, input field backgrounds — the dominant structural neutral

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Secondary surface for elevated sections and secondary borders, providing one subtle step above the dominant #ebebeb

chalk-white.$description: Chalk White — Soft background wash for alternating sections and subtle card lift without shadows

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Muted helper text, disabled icon fills, and secondary metadata

ftbasicspace.$description: Single custom typeface used across all surfaces — UI chrome, product metadata, and section headlines. The 500/600 weights are reserved for product titles and brand labels (WAKA WAKA, RARIFY, PROSA), while 400 carries navigation, prices, and body. The signature is the tight negative tracking (-0.0220em at display sizes) which compresses the letterforms into a dense, almost monolinear rhythm — unlike typical e-commerce type that opens up, this tightens.
